selected_factors.name: LOW_REF
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: LOW_VOL_SUPPORT
selected_factors.reason: Prices hugging their recent low with low near-term volatility are more likely to rebound, as a stable base makes the support level more reliable.

selected_factors.name: LOW_CLOSE_5D_OVERSOLD_REVERSAL
selected_factors.reason: Stocks whose price is near a five-day low after a cumulative five-day decline are oversold and tend to mean-revert the next day, while truncation isolates this multi-day reversal signal without restating the one-day bounce factor.

selected_factors.name: CLOSE_NEAR_LOW_5
selected_factors.reason: Stocks that consistently close near their intraday lows are oversold and tend to rebound the next day, capturing a short-term reversal not captured by the absolute low-price ratio.

selected_factors.name: QTLU
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: LOW_DIP_REBOUND
selected_factors.reason: A deep low relative to the recent 5-day high combined with an intraday upward tick may signal a transient panic low that is being rejected, and normalizing by the recent high captures drawdown depth as a distinct cross-sectional signal from the close-based factor.

selected_factors.name: NEG_TREND_RESID_10
selected_factors.reason: Stocks trading below their short-term linear trend are oversold and tend to mean-revert upward the next day, and this detrended residual captures that reversal signal independently of the recent low/close level.

selected_factors.name: CLOSE_QUANTILE10_SUPPORT
selected_factors.reason: Stocks whose current close is near the lower quantile of their 20-day price distribution are oversold and tend to mean-revert upward, improving next-day returns.

selected_factors.name: FRESH_LOW_INTENSITY
selected_factors.reason: A fresh break below the prior 5-day low flags temporary panic overselling, and the subsequent next-day reversal tendency adds an orthogonal signal to the static distance-to-low factor.

selected_factors.name: HIGHER_LOW_5D
selected_factors.reason: Stocks trading near their short-term low while the low is drifting higher versus the prior 5-day window indicate early accumulation, so combining low proximity with a higher-low signal identifies rebound candidates.

selected_factors.name: LOG_TREND_REVERSAL
selected_factors.reason: Stocks trading below their 20-day log-linear price trend are temporarily oversold, and short-term mean reversion should lift next-day returns.

selected_factors.name: VSUMN
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: LOW_PRICE_VOLUME_DROUGHT
selected_factors.reason: A close near the 5-day low followed by shrinking recent volume signals exhausted selling pressure and a higher probability of next-day reversal.

selected_factors.name: IMIN
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: LOW_PRICE_VOLUME_EXHAUSTION
selected_factors.reason: Stocks near their 5-day low with shrinking volume have exhausted near-term selling pressure, so combining cheapness with downside volume contraction should improve next-day reversal.

selected_factors.name: LOW_CLOSE_VOL_CORR_BOUNCE
selected_factors.reason: A stock trading near its 5-day low whose price declines are accompanied by rising volume (negative return-volume correlation) is more likely to experience a short-term mean reversion bounce, so the factor ranks such stocks higher for next-day returns.

selected_factors.name: KUP2
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: SHORT_TERM_OVERSOLD_5_20
selected_factors.reason: When a stock closes near the low of its 5-day range while still far below its 20-day range high, it is short-term oversold and tends to mean-revert upward the next day.

selected_factors.name: OPEN_VOLUME_NEG_CORR
selected_factors.reason: A negative rolling correlation between open price and volume identifies rallies that lack volume confirmation, which tend to be followed by next-day reversals in A-shares.

selected_factors.name: TWENTY_DAY_DRAWDOWN
selected_factors.reason: Stocks whose current price is far below their 20-day maximum high are oversold and exhibit short-term reversal, so a deeper 20-day drawdown should lead to higher next-day returns.

selected_factors.name: LOW_PRICE_OVERNIGHT_GAP_REVERSAL
selected_factors.reason: Stocks trading near the 5 yuan psychological floor tend to be retail-speculative; recent positive overnight gaps overreact and revert next day, while negative gaps rebound, so conditioning on the low-price level and subtracting the recent overnight gap should improve next-day cross-sectional predictions.

selected_factors.name: SHORT_TERM_DRAWDOWN_5D
selected_factors.reason: A deeper drawdown from the close five days ago to the recent five-day low captures short-term overreaction, and such oversold stocks tend to mean-revert upward the next day.

selected_factors.name: DOWN_GAP_SUPPORT_BREAK
selected_factors.reason: Repeated opens below the prior day's low mark panic selling at the open; after such support breaks are overdone, the next-day return tends to mean-revert upward.

selected_factors.name: VMA
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: DOWN_DAY_RECOVERY
selected_factors.reason: Buying pressure on down days, measured as close-above-open strength on down closes relative to the recent range, captures informed dip-buying and short-term mean reversion, predicting higher next-day returns.

selected_factors.name: CLOSE_TO_52WEEK_HIGH
selected_factors.reason: Stocks trading near their 252-day high exhibit positive anchoring/momentum and tend to earn higher next-day returns in cross-section.

selected_factors.name: VOLUME_REF
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: LOW_SUPPORT_VOLUME_FILTER
selected_factors.reason: A close near the 5-day low is a stronger reversal signal when it is not accompanied by expanding volume, because low-volume tests of support are more likely to hold and bounce next day.

selected_factors.name: NEG_OVERNIGHT_GAP
selected_factors.reason: In Chinese A-shares, large negative overnight gaps capture retail overreaction and tend to be followed by a short-term rebound, so a higher value of this factor should predict a higher next-day return.

selected_factors.name: LOW_PROXIMITY_VOL_RATIO
selected_factors.reason: Stocks trading near their 5-day low but with declining short-term volatility relative to their 20-day norm are oversold yet not in free fall, so their next-day reversal probability is higher.
